Network-wide improvement claim · Evidence definition

Outcome definition, eligible cohort and calculation needed

Claim type
Network-wide outcome statement
Required basis
Defined outcome, denominator and period
Source status
Company publications
Assurance scope
Outcome-study figures excluded from practitioner report scope

What this supports

The company publications contain a headline improvement claim and a twelve-study narrative. These identify the claim that needs a transparent evidence trail.

Scope & limits

The reviewed materials do not establish the full network-wide calculation or make it an individual outcome guarantee. Practitioner assurance over operational counts does not validate excluded outcome percentages.

Before using the percentage in a public verification conclusion, document eligibility, baseline/follow-up, missing data, assessment version, calculation and study links.
